default.description: Env name used when `cce` is invoked without -e/--env. null or empty means no injection.

lang.description: UI language for cce output (help, warnings, errors, prompts). null = auto-detect from OS locale. Overridden by the CCE_LANG env var; set persistently with `cce lang <en|zh-CN|auto>`.

args.description: Global default claude args (shell-tokenized string). Prepended to every claude launch unless a per-env entry has `argsOverride: true`, or the user passes -A on the CLI. Example: "--permission-mode bypassPermissions"

settingsMode.description: Global default for how a selected env's `env` reconciles with ~/.claude/settings.json's `env` (cce never edits settings.json; it builds a temp file passed to `claude --settings`). override: this env fully wins, stale anthropic keys in settings.json are neutralized. merge-cce: union, this env wins on conflicts. merge-claude: union, settings.json wins on conflicts. Overridden per-env by `envs.<name>.settingsMode` and per-run by the -m/--merge-mode flag.

updateMode.description: How cce self-updates at launch. auto (default): silently install a newer version in the background. prompt: on the next interactive launch, show an Update now / Skip this version menu (a skipped version is not offered again until a newer one ships). off: never check at launch. Manual `cce update` works regardless. The launch check is throttled to ~3h and only prompts in a TTY; disable a single run with CCE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1.

env.description: Environment variables to inject into the claude child process. Matches the shape of Claude Code's settings.json `env` block, so values can be copy-pasted directly. Values may contain ${VAR} placeholders resolved from the parent shell env.

args.description: Per-env default claude args (shell-tokenized string). By default merged onto the global `args`; set `argsOverride: true` to replace the global args instead.

argsOverride.description: If true, this env's `args` replace the global `args` entirely. If false (default), they are merged onto the global args (pure concatenation).

settingsMode.description: Per-env override of how this env's `env` reconciles with ~/.claude/settings.json's `env`. Omit to inherit the global `settingsMode`. override: this env fully wins (stale anthropic keys neutralized). merge-cce: union, this env wins. merge-claude: union, settings.json wins.
